description: Reference outlives its referent
rationale: Accessing freed memory is undefined behavior
fix_template: Return owned value or ensure referent lives long enough

description: Lifetime of reference does not satisfy constraint
rationale: Function signature requires longer lifetime than provided

description: Lifetime elision applies: single input lifetime → output
rationale: Compiler infers output lifetime from single input ref

description: Lifetime elision: &self lifetime used for output references
rationale: Methods returning references use &self's lifetime

description: 'static means lives for entire program; string literals are 'static
rationale: Only constants and leaked values are truly 'static

description: Higher-ranked trait bounds: for<'a> Fn(&'a T)
rationale: Function works for any lifetime of the argument

description: Struct holding references needs lifetime parameter
rationale: Struct cannot outlive its borrowed fields

description: impl block may need lifetime parameter if struct has one
rationale: impl<'a> Foo<'a> matches struct Foo<'a>

description: Closure borrows may require explicit lifetime annotation
rationale: Closure captures can create complex lifetime requirements
fix_template: Move values into closure or annotate lifetime

description: Covariant lifetime: &'long T can be used where &'short T expected
rationale: Subtyping allows shrinking lifetimes

description: Contravariant lifetime: fn(&'short T) can be used where fn(&'long T) expected
rationale: Function parameters are contravariant

description: &mut T is invariant in T — cannot change the type
rationale: Mutable references require exact type match

description: Reborrow creates a shorter-lived reference from &mut
rationale: Temporary reborrow allows interleaving uses

description: Trait objects have implicit lifetime bound
rationale: Box<dyn Trait> defaults to Box<dyn Trait + 'static>
fix_template: Add explicit lifetime bound if needed

description: 'a: 'b means 'a outlives 'b
rationale: If 'a outlives 'b, &'a T can be used where &'b T expected

description: Functions can have multiple lifetime parameters for different borrows
rationale: Separate lifetimes when inputs have different origins

description: '_ is the anonymous/elided lifetime placeholder
rationale: Used in impls and function signatures for readability

description: Lifetime bound on generic: T: 'a means T must outlive 'a
rationale: Type must not contain references shorter than 'a

description: Early-bound lifetimes are set at call site; late-bound during use
rationale: Affects when the lifetime is determined

description: NLL two-phase borrows allow nested method calls
rationale: Activation of mutable borrow deferred to first mutation

description: Polonius is an experimental borrow checker with better precision
rationale: May accept programs the current checker rejects

description: Drop-check may require PhantomData to assert ownership
rationale: Compiler checks drop doesn't use dangling references

description: Pin enables self-referential structures by preventing moves
rationale: Required for async state machines

description: Async functions capture all parameter lifetimes
rationale: Returned Future must satisfy all input lifetimes
fix_template: Use owned values or explicit lifetime bounds

description: Stacked Borrows: formal model for reference aliasing rules
rationale: Miri uses this to detect UB in unsafe code

description: Tree Borrows: newer alternative model to Stacked Borrows
rationale: More permissive; may become the standard model

description: Rc/Arc extend lifetime via reference counting
rationale: Value lives until last Rc/Arc is dropped

description: Box::leak converts owned to &'static
rationale: Value lives forever; potential memory leak

description: Scope guards ensure cleanup at end of scope — ties lifetime to scope
rationale: RAII pattern: resource released when guard drops

description: Temporaries bound to let have extended lifetime
rationale: let x = &temp extends temp's life to match x

description: Compiler infers lifetimes during type inference
rationale: Explicit annotations only needed when ambiguous

description: Generic Associated Types allow lifetime-parameterized associated types
rationale: GATs enable lending iterators and related patterns

description: Return-position impl Trait in trait: returned type captures lifetimes
rationale: Returned opaque type may hold borrows from inputs

description: impl Trait return types have anonymous existential lifetime
rationale: Compiler picks the appropriate lifetime

description: Values sent across threads must satisfy 'static or explicit lifetime constraints
rationale: Thread may outlive the sender's scope
fix_template: Use owned values or Arc for shared data
